_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: /clear clears the context and starts a new generation, keeping the older messages on screen. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/before-clear and wait (up to 30s) for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible. 2. There must be no generation divider yet: ".generation-divider" count 0. 3. Fill the message input with "/clear". 4. The send button (data-testid "send-button") should become enabled (up to 5s); click it. 5. Exactly one generation divider (".generation-divider") should appear (count 1, wait up to 30s). 6. The message input should become empty (its value is exactly "", wait up to 30s; the composer clears only after the send's response arrives, so it may lag the divider). 7. The first message (data-testid "message") containing "before clear" should still be visible.
